reason: 控制一侧有较多兑现：DMCA 反规避、DRM 与平台门禁确实加强了对网络使用的约束；但 2001 年后 Web 2.0、开源、维基与智能手机等持续爆发，不能认定创新在互联网与社会中被整体削弱。合取命题只部分成立。

reason: 应用商店、DRM 与围墙花园等确实重新引入了部分被早期互联网消解的门槛；但 YouTube、独立发布与开源工具同时大幅降低了创作与分发门槛。障碍被部分而不是原样整体“重新引入”。
quote: being changed in ways that will reintroduce the very barriers that the Internet originally removed.

reason: 预测以“律师解决主权/频谱之争之时”为时间条件。部族频谱主权与接入差距在 2020 年代仍在立法与政策过程中，Hendricks 方案所涉那场法律战并未形成可据以检验速度对比的明确完结，条件未触发。

reason: “下一世纪至少”尚未走完，不能判完全正确；但至截止日印刷书仍占销售与阅读的主体（约三四倍于电子书，调查显示更多人仍读纸书），与“实体书仍是文化核心”的方向高度一致。
quote: physical books are extremely durable information sources. They are stable and preserve relatively well. They read well in many contexts; they will be a central part of culture for the next century, at least.
claim: Physical books will be a central part of culture for the next century, at least.

reason: “不久后能以传统工具约 1% 的成本为数字设备制作高质量影片”在能力意义上方向正确（数字摄影、低成本独立制作、以至 iPhone 剧情长片如 Tangerine）；精确的 1% 比率缺乏系统对照，故作趋势符合而非完全正确。

claim: Filmmakers will soon be able to produce high-quality film for digital devices at 1 percent of the cost of the same production with traditional tools.

reason: “除非被阻止”的条件未实现为普遍叫停：推荐系统在亚马逊、Netflix、YouTube、TikTok 等成为核心，并持续提高对个人偏好的预测与投放，与原断言一致。
quote: As it matures, the technology (unless stopped) will increasingly be able to predict what you, as an individual, will want; it will increasingly waste less of your time on what you don’t want. And this will increase your demand for the things the Net sells.
claim: As preference-matching technology matures, unless it is stopped, it will increasingly be able to predict what an individual will want, waste less of that person’s time on unwanted offers, and thereby increase demand for things the Net sells.

reason: 基于偏好数据的定向与程序化广告成长为远大于传统 0.5% 反馈率渠道的产业，单位成本与定向效率总体更高；但广告欺诈与展示无效使“高得多的回报”并非一律成立，故趋势符合。

claim: The ability to capture and use preference-data resources will reduce advertising costs dramatically, and these technologies will produce a much greater return at a lower cost than technologies that produce a 0.5 percent return.

reason: 条件部分成立：Cisco 类策略路由/管控产品确被部署，有线商如 Comcast 也曾干扰 P2P。但网络中立规则、OTT 视频崛起限制了“由网络决定用途与内容”的全面围墙花园，控制被部分而非完整兑现。
quote: And if the business model that Cisco sells is as attractive as Cisco sells it to be, then we should expect that cable will continue to exercise control in the future. It will architect and enforce a network where the kinds of uses and content that run on the network are as the network chooses
claim: If the business model that Cisco sells is as attractive as Cisco presents it, cable companies will continue to exercise control in the future and will architect and enforce a network whose uses and content are chosen by the network.

reason: 地理屏蔽、数据本地化、GDPR 及各国内容规制等表明，未来互联网上的生活确实在相当程度上按属地再规制，与 Goldsmith/Sykes 所描述、Lessig 所断言的方向一致。
quote: Jack Goldsmith and Alan Sykes have described the growing collection of technologies that will achieve the same end.26 These suggest that the future will be very much like the past: life on the future Internet will be regulated locally, just as life before the Internet was regulated locally.
claim: Life on the future Internet will be regulated locally, just as life before the Internet was regulated locally; the future will be very much like the past.

reason: Eldred 维持版权延期、DMCA 与专利主张实体等确实在边际上护卫了在位者；同时 eBay v. MercExchange、合理使用与部分专利改革又给新进入者留下空间。旧对新的保护是部分而非单向的。
quote: In both contexts, the emerging regime will have a significant regulatory effect. In both contexts, the regime will shift protection from the new to the old. The law in both cases will, on the margin, protect the old against the new.
claim: In the copyright and patent contexts Lessig has just described, the emerging intellectual-property regime will have a significant regulatory effect, will shift protection from the new to the old, and the law will, on the margin, protect the old against the new.

reason: 许可频谱仍大量按排他权利拍卖，分享技术面对在位权利的摩擦真实存在；但 TV 白空间、CBRS、Wi-Fi 6E 等分享制度也在 2001 年后建成。财产化使分享更难，却并未杜绝分享。
quote: Once that property is established, it will be harder to deploy technologies that “share” other people’s “property.”
claim: Once spectrum is established as property, it will be harder to deploy technologies that share other people’s property.

reason: 美国频谱拍卖收入在 1994–2009 年已达约 526 亿美元，其后继续累积（含 700MHz、AWS-3 等大拍），远超书中“这些出售的预期收入将超过 500 亿美元”的阈值。

claim: Expected revenue from then-current spectrum sales will exceed $50 billion, and that revenue will put pressure on incumbents to earn supracompetitive returns.

reason: CSS/DRM、DMCA 反规避与 Content ID 确实削弱了合法抽取与混剪影片的能力；但 YouTube 混剪文化、合理使用实践与后来的规避例外又表明“完全剥夺这一能力”并未发生。
quote: The law says that their creation can’t be shared and the technologies that we’ve seen in chapter 11 will take away the very ability to draw upon film content and mix it with something different.
claim: The copyright-protecting technologies described in chapter 11 will take away the ability to draw upon film content and mix it with something different.

reason: 2001–2006 年间微软在操作系统与浏览器上仍有支配力，互联网也确实与前十年不同；但 AOL–Time Warner 迅速失势，Google 等成为更关键的定义者，创新并不只按这两家平台许可展开。
quote: These two companies—AOL Time Warner and Microsoft—will define the next five years of the Internet’s life. Neither company has committed itself to a neutral and open platform.8 Hence, the next five years will be radically different from the past ten.
claim: AOL Time Warner and Microsoft will define the next five years of the Internet’s life; because neither has committed itself to a neutral and open platform, the next five years will be radically different from the past ten, and innovation in content and applications will be as these platform owners permit.
